title: One file format change: three files to edit when the format leaks, one file when a deep module hides it
captions: Design A. The writer, the payout job and the report each build or split the CSV line themselves. All three know the column order: id, then amount, then date.
A new tax column goes after the id. The writer is updated. The payout job and the report must change too. If someone misses one, it reads the tax as the amount.
Design B. One module, InvoiceFile, owns the format. The other parts only call write(path, invoices) and read(path). The column order is hidden inside it.
The same change now happens inside InvoiceFile only. The callers still get invoice objects, so none of them changes.
